newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian police seize 706 kg of marijuana.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian police seize 706 kg of marijuana.

text.p: Cambodian police on Thursday seized 706 kg (1,553 lb) of marijuana apparently destined for export, raising fears that drug trafficking is worsening in the country, police officials said.
Seven Cambodian men and one woman were arrested at a guest house in Phnom Penh and expected to be charged on Friday for drug trafficking, Police General Skadavy M. Ly Roun said.
He said the haul originated in the southern coastal town of Sre Ambel, while an Interior Ministry official said it was from the southern port city of Sihanoukville.
The general said it was destined for export, possibly to Thailand or Vietnam.
Last year, 59 tonnes of marijuana from Cambodia were seized overseas and the United States placed Cambodia on its list of leading drug trafficking nations.
